measure.measure_definition: Time to event: randomization to earliest disease progression or death from any cause; Participants; Tumor response assessed by CT scans every 3 months from baseline until treatment discontinuation or death; imaging reviewed by an independent radiologist blinded to treatment allocation; RECIST v1.1 used to define objective progression. Patients were followed for survival until death or consent withdrawal.; PFS was the time from randomization to the earliest occurrence of objective disease progression according to RECIST v1.1 or death from any cause. Patients lost to follow-up, alive, and without reported progression were censored at the date of last visit.

Time to event: randomization to death from any cause; Participants; Patients were followed for survival until death from any cause or consent withdrawal; vital status was assessed after randomization.; OS was the time from randomization until death from any cause. Patients alive or lost to follow-up were censored at the date of last visit/contact as reported.

Categorical status: best overall response of complete response or partial response according to RECIST v1.1; Participants; CT scans every 3 months from baseline until treatment discontinuation or death; independent radiologist blinded to treatment allocation; RECIST v1.1. Response-evaluable patients had at least one imaging assessment.; Objective response rate was defined as the proportion of patients achieving a complete response (CR) or partial response (PR). No complete responses were observed. The response-evaluable denominators were 49 patients in the Tr + RHT arm and 46 in the Tr arm.

population.intervention: Trabectedin with or without regional hyperthermia (RHT)
population.intervention_regimen: Trabectedin 1.5 mg/m2 body surface area; RHT 42°C for 60 minutes in the Tr + RHT arm; Trabectedin as a 24-hour continuous intravenous infusion every 3 weeks; RHT applied at the end of the infusion in the Tr + RHT arm; treatment continued until progression, unacceptable toxicity, consent withdrawal, or death, with protocol-defined dose reductions.
population.population_definition: All eligible randomized patients, both treatment arms combined; Adults with histologically confirmed advanced soft tissue sarcoma (primary or recurrent) who had failed at least one anthracycline-based chemotherapy or were unsuited to it, were randomized 1:1 to Tr + RHT or Tr, and were included in the intention-to-treat analysis regardless of treatment received. Two randomized patients in the Tr arm were excluded before the efficacy analysis: one screening failure and one duplicate randomization.
population.population_time_frame: Enrolment 19 December 2014 to 7 December 2021; efficacy data cut-off 30 September 2022.
